title: Night Prayer for Healing | Rest Your Body and Heart in God's Care
description:
Hurting in body or heart? Bring every pain to the God who heals, then fall asleep to healing Scripture read slowly over you: Psalm 103, Psalm 23, Psalm 46, Isaiah 43 and more.

Chapters
0:00 Good evening
0:39 Heal me, O Lord (Jeremiah 17:14)
1:30 He binds up wounds (Psalm 147:3)
2:17 Psalm 41:3
3:40 Healing for the heart
4:10 By his stripes (Isaiah 53:5)
5:29 Be still (Psalm 46:10)
5:48 Psalm 6:2
6:16 2 Corinthians 4:16
8:01 Psalm 30:2
8:07 Forget not his benefits (Psalm 103:2-3)
9:32 No more pain (Revelation 21:4)
10:22 Romans 8:28
11:52 Declaration for tonight
12:12 Psalm 3:5
12:40 One thing to do tonight
12:55 Healing Scripture for sleep
14:36 Who healeth all thy diseases (Psalm 103)
16:04 He restoreth my soul (Psalm 23)
17:08 Be still and know (Psalm 46)
18:08 Through the waters (Isaiah 43:1-2)
18:57 Renewed day by day (2 Corinthians 4:16-18)
19:44 Wait on the Lord (Psalm 27:13-14)
20:17 Nigh unto the broken hearted (Psalm 34)
20:59 He that keepeth thee (Psalm 121)
21:57 The peace of God (Philippians 4:6-7)
22:29 Perfect peace (Isaiah 26:3-4)
23:00 He calleth the stars by name (Psalm 147:3-5)
23:38 The lifter up of mine head (Psalm 3:3-5)
24:13 Under his wings (Psalm 91)
25:13 Blessing

Scripture in this prayer: Jeremiah 17:14; Psalm 147:3; Psalm 41:3; Isaiah 53:5; Psalm 46:10; Psalm 6:2; 2 Corinthians 4:16; Psalm 30:2; Psalm 103:2-3; Revelation 21:4; Romans 8:28; Psalm 3:5; Psalm 103:1-5, 8-13; Psalm 23; Psalm 46:1-3, 10-11; Isaiah 43:1-2; 2 Corinthians 4:16-18; Psalm 27:13-14; Psalm 34:4, 8, 18; Psalm 121; Philippians 4:6-7; Isaiah 26:3-4; Psalm 147:3-5; Psalm 3:3-5; Psalm 91:1-2, 4, 9-11; 3 John 1:2

Scripture quotations: King James Version (public domain).
